description: This file defines the 'LoanOverAppliedCalculationType' enum used to specify calculation types (flat or percentage) for loan over-applied scenarios in the loan account domain.

classes.name: LoanOverAppliedCalculationType
classes.description: An enumeration for different calculation types related to over-application in loan processing, providing methods to retrieve options and check types.

methods.name: getValuesAsEnumOptionDataList
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects representing all enum values.

methods.name: asEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts the enum constant to an EnumOptionData instance.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if the enum value is FLAT.

methods.name: isPercentage
methods.description: Checks if the enum value is PERCENTAGE.
